title: Stickman Run
description: My hand-built Unity grappling platformer — swing, wall-jump and clear a lava cave — rebuilt to play right here in the browser.
longDescription: Stickman Run (titled “Stick Boi Adventure” in-game) is a 2D cave platformer I built by hand in Unity with C#: a grappling hook that swings off any surface, wall-jumps, crouch-slides, a pistol with regenerating ammo, slow motion, and a cave full of gunners. Recovering the shipped Windows build and rewriting the gameplay for HTML5 canvas keeps the original level layout, physics values, art and audio — no engine runtime to download. A behind-the-scenes mode redraws the whole level as an engineering blueprint, showing every collider, pickup, hinge joint and the recovered tuning.

title: UVM Ski Ride Share
description: A ride-sharing platform helping UVM students coordinate trips to Vermont ski mountains.
longDescription: Built to help UVM students organize ski trips, cutting coordination overhead from hours to minutes. Features student authentication, trip listings, and coordination messaging.

title: Drone Circuit Testing
description: Arduino-based circuit boards in C++ for quality testing wildfire mitigation drone payloads.
longDescription: During my internship at Drone Amplified, I assembled, tested, and evaluated drone systems and payloads designed for wildfire mitigation. I coded circuit boards for quality testing using Arduino and C++.

title: AI Accessibility Tool
description: Scans document headers with AI to generate contextually relevant imagery for accessible learning.
longDescription: A web tool that scans document headers with AI to generate contextually relevant imagery. Designed to aid students with hearing impairments by making reading-based learning more engaging for non-auditory learners.

title: Voicyd
description: Refreshed Voicyd's public website to its current live experience, aligning its product presentation with the service.
longDescription: Updated Voicyd's public-facing website to its current live version. The work focused on bringing the site's presentation in line with the product people encounter today. Explore the live site to see the current experience.

title: LearnFlow
description: AI-assisted learning companion that turns YouTube videos into interactive study sessions.
longDescription: LearnFlow helps learners move beyond passive video watching. Users can watch a YouTube video in the app, ask an AI tutor questions about its subject, and respond to learning checkpoints that encourage deeper understanding as the video plays.
